_doc: Dock styles for src/docks.js (docs/docks.md). A style names materials from _materials for each part, member sizes, pontoon type, rail type and a dressing palette (manifest ids). wear blends deck.new -> deck.weathered. Assets owns this file. ramp.camber_m: default mid-span rise of the gangway arc in metres (0 = flat); dock.json ramps[].camber_m overrides it. Plank materials carry rows (board rows across the texture) and span_m (metres the texture covers): Geo.plank gives every plank one board row, a random grain offset, flip and tint.
